notes.EXACT_DUPLICATE_SOURCE_ROWS: All captured import fields are identical. Safe candidate for keeping one source row after manual spot-check.
notes.EAN_AS_PRODUCT_NUMBER_COPY: One record uses the EAN itself as productNumber while another record shares the EAN. Not a variant decision.
notes.SOFORT_OR_LEGACY_COPY: At least one record is marked Sofort in its product number or name. Marker only; requires business decision.
notes.SAME_NAME_DIFFERENT_SOURCE_RECORD: Same display name but different source fields or productNumber.
notes.CONFLICTING_PRODUCTS_SAME_EAN: Different product numbers and names share an EAN. Must not be auto-imported as one product or variant.
